text: SuperFile, the Chicago-based digital file-security company that became title partner of the Trackhouse MotoGP team in 2026, is led by its founder and CEO Shane Valdez.
short: SuperFile is a Chicago file-security company led by founder and CEO Shane Valdez.

source.name: Trackhouse: SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team (Wayback Machine copy)
source.note: The club press release describes SuperFile as a Chicago-based digital file-security company and attributes its quote to 'Shane Valdez, Founder & CEO - SuperFile'.
